# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 L7 the last siege (phases 1-3). Generated by gen_l7_after1453.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 32); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start; close; the City lost in war (end 5); the siege may come again
# after a bought peace; the siege itself. Phase 2 adds block 乙 after the siege.
oe_l7_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_l7_live } } set_global_variable = oe_l7_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_on } } set_variable = oe_l7_on set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 0 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1481.1.1 }
            set_variable = oe_l7_off
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_end } } oe_l7_set_end = { e = 6 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
            debug_log = "oe_l7: the line is closed (end [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l7_rd_end')|0])"
        }
        else = {
            oe_l7_watch = yes
            oe_l7_again = yes
            oe_l7_siege = yes
            oe_l7_after = yes
            oe_l7_kept = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_l7_all_done = yes }
                set_variable = oe_l7_off
                debug_log = "oe_l7: every event after the fall has come or lapsed; the line is closed (end [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l7_rd_end')|0])"
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. End 5 (design 3.3 item 2): the Ottomans hold the City and we do not, from 1400.1.1, with no end
# yet, or after the City was held (1) or peace bought (4) and then lost in a real war. No pop-up; phase 2 starts block
# 乙 the month after.
oe_l7_watch = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_date >= 1400.1.1
            OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_end } var:oe_l7_end ?= 1 var:oe_l7_end ?= 4 }
            NOT = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
            location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:TUR }
        }
        oe_l7_set_end = { e = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fall_m value = var:oe_l7_m }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_resend } remove_variable = oe_l7_resend }
        debug_log = "oe_l7: the City was lost in war (end 5, month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l7_rd_m')|0])"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. After a bought peace (4), 120 months on, the siege may come once more (design 3.3 item 3);
# .3 then has no option to buy peace (oe_l7_bought stays). The gift of .1 c stays used.
oe_l7_again = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l7_end ?= 4 has_variable = oe_l7_again_m var:oe_l7_m >= var:oe_l7_again_m }
        remove_variable = oe_l7_end
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_l7_end } remove_global_variable = oe_l7_end }
        remove_variable = oe_l7_again_m
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_doom_n value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_prep } remove_variable = oe_l7_prep }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_appeal } remove_variable = oe_l7_appeal }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_stall } remove_variable = oe_l7_stall }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_odds } remove_variable = oe_l7_odds }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_due } remove_variable = oe_l7_due }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_wait_n } remove_variable = oe_l7_wait_n }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_resend } remove_variable = oe_l7_resend }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_captain } remove_variable = oe_l7_captain }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_m1 } remove_variable = oe_l7_m1 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_2 } remove_variable = oe_l7_st_2 }
        debug_log = "oe_l7: ten years after the bought peace, the siege may come again"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The siege (design 3.3 item 4).
oe_l7_siege = {
    # months of doom in a row (the sure month of .1)
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_doom_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_doom_n value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l7_doom = yes oe_l7_ott_ok = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_l7_doom_n add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_doom_n value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l7_st ?= 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_l7_doom = yes oe_l7_calm = yes oe_l7_ott_ok = yes oe_ml_free = yes oe_l7_ev_1 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_l7_ch_1 oe_l7_send_1 = yes }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        # the fortress stands: .3 at the due month if the doom still holds (it does not wait for the lock); otherwise
        # wait, and after 24 months of waiting (not counting months at war with the Ottomans) the sultan withdraws.
        limit = { var:oe_l7_st ?= 1 has_variable = oe_l7_due var:oe_l7_m >= var:oe_l7_due }
        if = { limit = { oe_l7_doom = yes oe_l7_ev_3 = yes } oe_l7_send_3 = yes oe_l7_lapse_2 = yes }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_wait_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_wait_n value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_l7_wait_n add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_l7_wait_n >= 24 }
                oe_l7_set_end = { e = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_l7_why value = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
                oe_l7_send_4 = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        # phase 2, .2: the fortress stands and .3 is not due yet; from the 3rd month after .1, 30% a
        # month, sure the month before .3; waits for calm and the lock (it never delays .3: when .3 comes first, .2 lapses).
        limit = {
            var:oe_l7_st ?= 1
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_2 }
            oe_l7_since_1 >= 3
            oe_l7_calm = yes
            oe_ml_free = yes
            oe_l7_ev_2 = yes
        }
        random = { chance = oe_l7_ch_2 oe_l7_send_2 = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        # .3 d: the sultan asks again a month later (the chance is worked out again by the sender)
        limit = { var:oe_l7_st ?= 2 has_variable = oe_l7_resend var:oe_l7_m >= var:oe_l7_resend oe_l7_ev_3 = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_l7_resend
        oe_l7_send_3 = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The senders. The monthly check and the test buttons both use them, so a button shows the event exactly
# as the month would (r21: a value the sender stores is missing when an event is fired from the console).
# .1: the fortress; .3 comes 8-14 months later.
oe_l7_send_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_1 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_due value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m1 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    random_list = {
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 8 } }
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 9 } }
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 10 } }
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 11 } }
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 12 } }
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 13 } }
        1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due add = 14 } }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.1
}
# .3: the chance to hold is worked out and stored (oe_l7_odds) for the text, the tooltips and the roll.
oe_l7_send_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_odds value = oe_l7_hold_chance }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_3 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 3 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.3
}
# .4: the outcome (its variant follows oe_l7_end and oe_l7_why).
oe_l7_send_4 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_4 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 4 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.4
}
oe_l7_send_4_later = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_4 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 4 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_l7.4 days = 30 }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 d: count the stall; the sultan asks again a month later.
oe_l7_stall_set = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_stall } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_stall value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_stall add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_resend value = oe_ml_month_now }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_resend add = 1 }
}
# Any scope. The end, kept on the empire and as a global (the chronicle, later phases, other lines: design 3.10).
oe_l7_set_end = {
    c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_end value = $e$ } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_l7_end value = $e$ }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month); manpower: the new-cost rule of brief B6 (only while it grows).
oe_l7_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_l7_men = { if = { limit = { monthly_manpower > 0 } add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -$months$ } } }

# BYZ scope. Fires the hidden worker oe_l7.90 with job $j$ (option effects stay out of the option previews).
oe_l7_run_job = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_job value = $j$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.90
}

# ---- the engine forms not yet seen in game (brief): each in ONE effect, behind a generator switch.
# BYZ scope. The new capital (design 3.5): Mystrás while the Despotate of the Morea stands and Mystrás is ours, under our
# control and not besieged; else our most populous place that is not the capital, under our control, not besieged.
# Saves scope:oe_l7_cap (none when there is no such place).
oe_l7_pick_cap = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mo_despotate location:mystras = { owner ?= c:BYZ controller ?= c:BYZ has_siege = no is_capital = no } }
        location:mystras = { save_scope_as = oe_l7_cap }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { is_capital = no controller ?= c:BYZ has_siege = no }
            order_by = population
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_l7_cap
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Hand the City to the AI Ottomans and move the capital, in one effect (design 3.5, 7.3; switches
# SET_CAPITAL_FIRST = True, HANDOVER = change_location_owner). First the re-check (oe_l7_may_cede_city), then the
# new capital, then the move and the handover, then the self-check: oe_l7_hand 1 when the Ottomans own the City, else 0
# and a failure code in oe_l7_fail (1 the handover did not take; 2 the capital did not move, so the City was not handed
# over; 3 handed over, but the capital is not where it was sent; 4 nothing could start). Nothing depends on the code.
oe_l7_hand_city = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_hand value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_fail } remove_variable = oe_l7_fail }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_l7_may_cede_city = yes }
        oe_l7_pick_cap = yes
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_l7_cap }
            set_variable = { name = oe_l7_newcap value = scope:oe_l7_cap }
            # SET_CAPITAL_FIRST: the capital moves first; the City is handed over only once the move took.
            set_capital = scope:oe_l7_cap
            if = {
                limit = { capital = scope:oe_l7_cap }
                location:constantinople = { change_location_owner = c:TUR }
                if = { limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_hand value = 1 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 1 } }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 2 } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 4 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 4 } }
}
# BYZ scope. A truce of $years$ years with the Ottomans after the handover (switch TRUCE = True; not seen in game).
oe_l7_truce_tur = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = $years$ mutual = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. The emperor falls on the walls (.4 f a; design 六 item 8; switch KILL = silent): an adult ruler only. Then
# the successor's legitimacy. Self-check: the ruler saved before is dead, else oe_l7_fail = 6 (nothing depends on it).
# Vanilla records marbled_emperor itself when the ruler of BYZ dies (_hardcoded.txt).
oe_l7_kill_emperor = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { is_adult = yes } }
        ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_l7_emp }
        kill_character_silently = scope:oe_l7_emp
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_l7_emp = { is_alive = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 6 } }
        add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 6 } }
}

# ---- the worker's jobs (oe_l7.90)
# 1: .3 a, defend: the roll on the stored chance (oe_l7_odds; the test buttons l7roll0 / l7roll1 fix it once through
# oe_l7_force: 1 fails, 2 holds). Held: end 1. Lost: the handover (the capital moves first), a truce of 10
# years, the claim stays; end 2. Then .4 a month later.
oe_l7_job_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_force } }
        random = { chance = oe_l7_odds_now set_variable = { name = oe_l7_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_force } remove_variable = oe_l7_force }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l7_roll = 1 }
        oe_l7_set_end = { e = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_l7_hand_city = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_hand ?= 1 } oe_l7_truce_tur = { years = 10 } set_variable = oe_l7_claim }
        oe_l7_set_end = { e = 2 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_l7_roll
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_resend } remove_variable = oe_l7_resend }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
    oe_l7_send_4_later = yes
}
# 11: .3 b, open the gates for the Morea: the handover, a truce of 10 years, the claim stays; end 3; .4 a month later.
oe_l7_job_11 = {
    oe_l7_hand_city = yes
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_hand ?= 1 } oe_l7_truce_tur = { years = 10 } set_variable = oe_l7_claim }
    oe_l7_set_end = { e = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_resend } remove_variable = oe_l7_resend }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
    oe_l7_send_4_later = yes
}
# 12: .4 f a, the emperor does not come back.
oe_l7_job_12 = {
    oe_l7_kill_emperor = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_emperor value = 1 }
}
# 21: .3 c, buy peace once (design 3.5): 9 months of income, then the tribute track's own effect (a new
# agreement: oe_ttb_peace_sign; one already running: another 5 years and one more year's tribute, as C7 does); end 4;
# the siege may come again 120 months later.
oe_l7_job_21 = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
        oe_l7_pay = { months = 9 }
        if = {
            limit = { c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } }
            save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_l7_amt value = oe_ttb_peace_amount }
            add_gold = { value = scope:oe_l7_amt multiply = -1 }
            c:TUR = { add_gold = scope:oe_l7_amt set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace value = var:oe_ttb_peace years = 5 } }
        }
        else = {
            c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
            oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
        }
        set_variable = oe_l7_bought
        oe_l7_set_end = { e = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_again_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        change_variable = { name = oe_l7_again_m add = 120 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_resend } remove_variable = oe_l7_resend }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
}
# ---- phase 2: jobs
# 22: .10 c, .11 a, the sultan's recognition / help: the tribute track's agreement without the nine months of .3 c (a new
# agreement: oe_ttb_peace_sign; one already running: another 5 years and one more year's tribute, as job 21 does).
oe_l7_job_22 = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
        if = {
            limit = { c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } }
            save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_l7_amt value = oe_ttb_peace_amount }
            add_gold = { value = scope:oe_l7_amt multiply = -1 }
            c:TUR = { add_gold = scope:oe_l7_amt set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace value = var:oe_ttb_peace years = 5 } }
        }
        else = {
            c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
            oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_trib value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 5 } }
}
# 23: .12 a, the tribute paid (the money in the option): a truce of 5 years with the Ottomans.
oe_l7_job_23 = {
    oe_l7_truce_tur = { years = 5 }
}
# ---- phase 3: jobs
# 30: .13 a, hold the isthmus: the roll on the stored chance (oe_l7_odds13; the test buttons l7r13f / l7r13h fix it once
# through oe_l7_force13: 1 fails, 2 holds). Held: end13 1. Lost: the Morea goes over (job 31's effect), a truce of
# 10 years; end13 2. Then .16 a month later.
oe_l7_job_30 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_roll13 value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_force13 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_roll13 value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_force13 } }
        random = { chance = oe_l7_odds13_now set_variable = { name = oe_l7_roll13 value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_force13 } remove_variable = oe_l7_force13 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l7_roll13 = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_end13 value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_l7_hand_morea = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_hand13 ?= 1 } oe_l7_truce_tur = { years = 10 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_end13 value = 2 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_l7_roll13
    oe_l7_send_16_later = yes
}
# 31: .13 c, give up the Morea and cross the sea (design 3.7): the Morea goes over, a truce of 10 years, the
# treasury carried away (2 months of income), oe_l7_exile 1; end13 3; .16 a month later.
oe_l7_job_31 = {
    oe_l7_hand_morea = yes

        limit = { var:oe_l7_hand13 ?= 1 }
        oe_l7_truce_tur = { years = 10 }
        add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_exile value = 1 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_end13 value = 3 }
    oe_l7_send_16_later = yes
}
# 40: .20 a, the ships: 60% they arrive (Trebizond gains oe_l7_tre_aid for 5 years); the news in .23.
oe_l7_job_40 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_tre value = 2 }
    random = { chance = 60 set_variable = { name = oe_l7_tre value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l7_tre ?= 1 country_exists = c:TRE }
        c:TRE = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_l7_tre_aid years = 5 mode = replace } }
    }
    oe_l7_send_23_later = yes
}
# 41: .20 b, money only: 1 month of our income goes to Trebizond.
oe_l7_job_41 = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_l7_amt3 value = oe_fin_month }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_l7_amt3 multiply = -1 }
        c:TRE = { add_gold = scope:oe_l7_amt3 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_tre value = 3 }
}
# BYZ scope. The Morea to the AI Ottomans (design 3.7 job 31), in one effect: first the re-check (oe_l7_may_cede_morea),
# then, when our capital is in the Morea, the capital moves to our most populous place outside it (under our control,
# not besieged); only then every place we hold in the Morea goes over (change_location_owner). Self-check: oe_l7_hand13 1 when we
# hold nothing in the Morea any more, else 0 and a failure code in oe_l7_fail (7 some places did not go over; 8 the
# capital did not leave the Morea, so nothing was handed over; 9 nothing could start). Nothing depends on the code.
oe_l7_hand_morea = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_hand13 value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_fail } remove_variable = oe_l7_fail }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_l7_may_cede_morea = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_l7_cap_morea = yes }
            ordered_owned_location = {
                limit = { NOT = { area ?= area:morea_area } controller ?= c:BYZ has_siege = no }
                order_by = population
                max = 1
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_l7_cap13
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_l7_cap13 } set_capital = scope:oe_l7_cap13 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_l7_cap_morea = yes } }
            area:morea_area = { every_location_in_area = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
            if = { limit = { oe_l7_morea_any = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 7 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_hand13 value = 1 } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 8 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fail value = 9 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .13 b: the arrears are wiped out (the money is paid in the option); .13 may come again 60 months later.
oe_l7_put_off_13 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_arrears value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_put13 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_put13 add = 60 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_end13 value = 4 }
}

# ---- phase 2: the senders and block 乙
# BYZ scope. .2: help within the walls.
oe_l7_send_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_2 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 2 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.2
}
# BYZ scope. When .3 comes before .2, .2 has lapsed.
oe_l7_lapse_2 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_2 value = 2 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .10: the court at the new capital; .12 first comes 60 months later.
oe_l7_send_10 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_10 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 10 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m10 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_due12 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due12 add = 60 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.10
}
# BYZ scope. .11: the Albanians rise.
oe_l7_send_11 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_11 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 11 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.11
}
# BYZ scope. .12: the sultan's tribute; counted, the next one 60 months later, done after 3.
oe_l7_send_12 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_n12 } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_n12 value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_n12 add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_due12 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_due12 add = 60 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_n12 >= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_12 value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 12 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.12
}
# BYZ scope. .12 b: one more year in arrears (phase 3's .13 reads the count; no war comes of it).
oe_l7_arrears_add = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_arrears } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_arrears value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_l7_arrears add = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly. Block 乙 (design 3.3 item 5, 3.6): only after the fall (oe_l7_fallen: end 2, 3 or 5 and the City not
# ours). The month the fall is first seen is kept (oe_l7_fall_m; end 5 sets it itself). At most one event a month:
# .10 the month after (does not wait for the lock: it takes it); .11 3-18 months after .10,
# 10% a month, while we hold 3+ places of the Morea, else it lapses; .12 every 60 months
# from .10, at most 3 times, only while there is no tribute agreement with the Ottomans and no war with them
# (it waits). .11 and .12 wait for calm and the lock. Phase 3 adds .13-.15 here.
oe_l7_after = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_l7_fallen = yes }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_fall_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_fall_m value = var:oe_l7_m } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_10 } oe_l7_since_fall >= 1 oe_l7_ev_10 = yes }
            oe_l7_send_10 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_l7_st_10 ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_11 } oe_l7_since_10 > 18 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_11 value = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                var:oe_l7_st_10 ?= 1
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_11 }
                oe_l7_since_10 >= 3
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_11 = yes
            }
            random = { chance = 10 oe_l7_send_11 = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                var:oe_l7_st_10 ?= 1
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_12 }
                has_variable = oe_l7_due12
                var:oe_l7_m >= var:oe_l7_due12
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_12 = yes
            }
            oe_l7_send_12 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            # phase 3, .13: the Morea's doom, 3% a month (+3% for each year in arrears)
            limit = {
                oe_l7_13_open = yes
                oe_l7_morea_doom = yes
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_13 = yes
            }
            random = { chance = oe_l7_ch_13 oe_l7_send_13 = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            # phase 3, .14: 60-240 months after the fall, 2% a month
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_14 }
                oe_l7_since_fall >= 60
                oe_l7_since_fall <= 240
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_14 = yes
            }
            random = { chance = 2 oe_l7_send_14 = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            # phase 3, .15: 1465.1.1 - 1481.1.1, 3% a month
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_15 }
                current_date >= 1465.1.1
                current_date < 1481.1.1
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_15 = yes
            }
            random = { chance = 3 oe_l7_send_15 = yes }
        }
        oe_l7_lapse_late = yes
    }
}

# ---- phase 3: the senders, the lapses and block 丙
# BYZ scope. .13: the chance to hold the Morea is worked out and stored (oe_l7_odds13) for the text, the tooltip and the
# roll; a .13 put off by its b comes back with no end13.
oe_l7_send_13 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_odds13 value = oe_l7_hold13 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_13 value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_end13 } remove_variable = oe_l7_end13 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 13 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.13
}
oe_l7_send_14 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_14 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 14 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.14
}
oe_l7_send_15 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_15 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 15 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.15
}
# .16: the outcome of .13 a / c, a month later (as .4 after .3).
oe_l7_send_16_later = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 16 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_l7.16 days = 30 }
}
oe_l7_send_20 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_20 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 20 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.20
}
oe_l7_send_21 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_21 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 21 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.21
}
oe_l7_send_22 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_22 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 22 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l7.22
}
# .23: the news of the fleet (.20 a), half a month later.
oe_l7_send_23_later = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_last value = 23 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_l7.23 days = 15 }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly (block 乙). .13 lapses when its window is over, .14 after 240 months (.15 with the line in 1481).
oe_l7_lapse_late = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_13 } current_date >= 1476.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_13 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_14 } oe_l7_since_fall > 240 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_14 value = 2 } }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly. Block 丙 (design 3.6): only while the City is ours and no siege is under way. .22 in its window for
# an empire never besieged (sure; it does not wait for the lock or calm, it takes the lock); .20 1455.1.1 - 1476.1.1 and
# .21 1470.1.1 - 1477.1.1, 10% / 10% a month, waiting for calm and the lock. At most one a month.
oe_l7_kept = {
    oe_l7_lapse_kept = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_l7_city_ours = yes oe_l7_no_siege = yes }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_22 }
                current_date >= 1453.5.29
                current_date < 1454.1.1
                oe_l7_never = yes
                oe_l7_ev_22 = yes
            }
            oe_l7_send_22 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_20 }
                current_date >= 1455.1.1
                current_date < 1476.1.1
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_20 = yes
            }
            random = { chance = 10 oe_l7_send_20 = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_21 }
                current_date >= 1470.1.1
                current_date < 1477.1.1
                oe_l7_north = yes
                oe_l7_calm = yes
                oe_ml_free = yes
                oe_l7_ev_21 = yes
            }
            random = { chance = 10 oe_l7_send_21 = yes }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly. The lapses of block 丙: .22 is impossible (3) once the empire was besieged or had an end before
# its window closed, lapsed (2) after; .20 and .21 lapse when their windows are over.
oe_l7_lapse_kept = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_22 } current_date < 1454.1.1 NOT = { oe_l7_never = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_22 value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_22 } current_date >= 1454.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_22 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_20 } current_date >= 1476.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_20 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_21 } current_date >= 1477.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st_21 value = 2 } }
}

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. .1 now through its sender: the window, the chance, the doom, calm and the lock are left out; the event's
# own trigger (the City ours, the Ottomans AI) is still checked.
oe_l7_test_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l7_ev_1 = yes } oe_l7_send_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l7 test: .1 cannot be shown (the City is not ours, or the Ottomans are gone, a player, a subject, or the house of Osman joined the empire)" }
}
# Current player's country (the test page is the empire's). .3 through its sender: the chance is worked out and stored,
# then the event comes to the current player (r21 rule; brief: l7send3).
oe_l7_test_send3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { tag = BYZ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = { limit = { oe_l7_ev_3 = yes } oe_l7_send_3 = yes }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_l7 test: .3 cannot be shown (the City is not ours, the Ottomans unfit, or at war with them)" }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l7 test: the current player is not the empire" }
}
# BYZ scope. Fix the next roll of .3 a: $r$ = 1 fails, 2 holds.
oe_l7_test_roll = { set_variable = { name = oe_l7_force value = $r$ } }
# BYZ scope. Show .4 at once: held (end 1), or fell (end 2, shown as if the City were lost: test flag oe_l7_e4test;
# no handover; its option a lets the emperor die).
oe_l7_test_4h = {
    oe_l7_set_end = { e = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_why } remove_variable = oe_l7_why }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
    oe_l7_send_4 = yes
}
oe_l7_test_4f = {
    oe_l7_set_end = { e = 2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_why } remove_variable = oe_l7_why }
    set_variable = oe_l7_e4test
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_st value = 3 }
    oe_l7_send_4 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The probe of design 5.2 item 1: the handover alone (capital, City, truce), and the self-check to the log.
oe_l7_test_fall = {
    oe_l7_hand_city = yes
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_hand ?= 1 } oe_l7_truce_tur = { years = 10 } }
    debug_log = "oe_l7 probe: hand=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l7_rd_hand')|0] fail=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l7_rd_fail')|0] (1 handover, 2 capital not moved so City kept, 3 capital elsewhere, 4 could not start) owner=[GetLocationByKey('constantinople').GetOwner.GetName] capital=[GetCountry('BYZ').GetCapital.GetName]"
}
# Any scope. A test game's setup (design 4.6 l7prep): the Ottomans take Adrianoúpolis and one neighbour of the City, only from
# AI owners other than the Ottomans (never a player's land; in a 1337 game the empire's own land is left alone).
oe_l7_test_prep = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = yes } }
        location:edirne = {
            if = { limit = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = TUR } } has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR }
        }
        location:constantinople = {
            random_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = TUR } } has_siege = no }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR
            }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Switch "the doom counts as true" for the monthly check (button l7doomx), or off again.
oe_l7_test_doom = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_doom_test } remove_variable = oe_l7_doom_test }
    else = { set_variable = oe_l7_doom_test }
}
# ---- phase 2 test buttons
# BYZ scope. .2 now through its sender (no stage, window, chance, calm or lock; the event's own trigger is checked).
oe_l7_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l7_ev_2 = yes } oe_l7_send_2 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l7 test: .2 cannot be shown (the City is not ours, or the Ottomans are gone, a player, a subject, or the house of Osman joined the empire)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Switch "the City counts as lost" (button l7aft) for block 乙 and the triggers of .10-.12; the City is NOT
# handed over. Press again to switch it off.
oe_l7_test_after = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_after_test } remove_variable = oe_l7_after_test }
    else = { set_variable = oe_l7_after_test }
}
# BYZ scope. .10 / .11 / .12 now through their senders (no window, chance, calm or lock; each event's own trigger is
# checked: after the fall or l7aft; .11 also 3+ places of the Morea; .12 also no tribute agreement and no war with the
# Ottomans, who are AI).
oe_l7_test_10 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l7_ev_10 = yes } oe_l7_send_10 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l7 test: .10 cannot be shown (the City is still ours and l7aft is off)" }
}
